anchor.meaning: Enemy body centre. Draw each frame with this pixel on the enemy position (e.x, e.y).

scaleRule: drawScale = LST.StatusLook.bodyR(e) / refBodyR (world units per sheet px); i.e. draw the frame at frame.w * bodyR/88 world units wide. Same art for every enemy type, no tint.

bottomEdge.meaning: Enemy body bottom edge (anchor.y + refBodyR). The goo band hugs this edge; drips hang below.

provenance.postProcess: _tools/process_v011.py build_disc (key bg + gray placeholder circle, un-mix, 2x2 cells, register circle centre on anchor, scale x0.8564 so circle = 2*refBodyR, strip)
provenance.license: Original generated art made for Brian Awsumb's Last Stand Tower; no third-party packs or licensed sheets.
provenance.prompt: 2x2 on flat magenta; same goo style as the v0.1.0 pick (refs venom_a.jpg + candidate 11); SMALL gray placeholder circle; goo curves around the round bottom and gathers into ONE big fat teardrop drip with two side nubs; no falling drops; bulge / stretch / bulb tip / spring back.
